notes.title: Release of KUBEON version 0.9.0
notes.content: [h1]Release of KUBEON version 0.9.0[/h1][p][/p][p]The 0.9.0 version of Kubeon brings the following changes:[/p][list][*][p]Modification of the level unlocking conditions (based on a minimum number of required stars) and addition of a total star counter on the level selection screen,[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustment of the sound effects volume in the menu,[/p][/*][*][p]Update of an enemy in level 5.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674910/3675501808c5829d50fdc3818936280228be279e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Feel free to share your feedback and stay updated on [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@game_dev_stories"]TikTok[/url], [url="https://x.com/siber_w"]X[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/gamedev_story/"]Instagram[/url] or [url="https://discord.com/invite/xAP6Gn2bhD"]Discord[/url].[/p][p]See you soon for the next steps <3[/p]
